what_it_does: MLP-Offload addresses the problem of limited GPU memory during large language model training by moving data to slower storage (CPU RAM, disk) when needed and bringing it back before use. Rather than moving everything at once, it uses multiple tiers of storage with different speeds and costs, and carefully schedules when to move optimizer state (gradient tracking information that trains the network) between them. This reduces the expensive I/O overhead that normally stops training from progressing.
